method: Krawczyk + interval Newton in Arb ball arithmetic: X=B(c0,r); N(X)=c0-f(c0)/f'(X); K(X)=c0-Y*f(c0)+(1-Y*f'(X))*(X-c0), Y=1/f'(c0); pass iff 0 notin f'(X), N(X) and K(X) strictly inside X, and inf_{c in X}|P_c^{2^j}(0)|>0 for all j=0..m; implies existence and uniqueness of a zero of P_c^n(0) in X of exact period n
